USER EVIDENCE
User confirms v66 connects and views photos quickly. Next screenshot shows
DSCF9186.JPG (listed655.6 KB) fails export with 'Read timed out',0 saved/1 failed.
This establishes a read timeout, not its precise command or byte position.
There is no real-camera completed-original or new-build export evidence yet.

CHANGES
Fuji original downloads request at most256 KiB instead of1 MiB per chunk,
retaining exact offset, response-size and complete-file checks.
GetPartialObject0x101B waits up to90 seconds for its first response byte.
After received bytes, a continuous30-second idle period ends the transaction.
Each original chunk still has an absolute180-second budget, preventing an
indefinite slow stream. Other metadata/preview transactions retain30 seconds.
One-second socket timeout polls retain the exact partial frame and wait within
those budgets. They never resend a command or treat an incomplete frame as
successful. Actual timeout/ambiguous partial-transfer exceptions close every
channel; existing controller cleanup and original JPEG verification remain.
Close/cancel remains independent of the API monitor and interrupts reads.

Timeout errors identify actual operation, property or original chunk handle,
offset/request length, header/body stage and response bytes received. This
replaces the uninformative raw English SocketTimeoutException message.
Response byte counts include PTP framing, not just original JPEG bytes.

VALIDATION
tests/run-fuji.ps1: PASS, including new virtual-clock scenarios:
  -45-second preparation plus2200 ms between16 KiB fragments: transfer passes,
   although individual chunks take more than the old30-second total budget.
  -Exact1 MiB+37-byte original delivered as256 KiB*4+37, with offsets
   0/262144/524288/786432/1048576 and no duplicate commands after socket polls.
  -No first byte fails at90 seconds; mid-frame stall fails at30 seconds idle;
   repeated20-second slow fragments fail at180 seconds absolute budget.
  -Metadata0x1008 still fails at30 seconds and is named correctly.
  -Failures close every channel, never output incomplete frames or resend.
  -Cancel during a socket poll stops immediately, before transfer budgets.
  -Existing JPEG suffix handling, cache, properties, framing, exact download,
   wrong identity/transaction, oversize/short data and cancellation tests pass.
The scripted socket and clock simulate timing; these are not hardware or
wall-clock throughput measurements.
tests/run-album.ps1: PASS

  Total1332 checks.
APK compile/signing, version, hash and bundled-fix checks: PASS.

LIMITS
The old screenshot lacks the failed operation and received-byte count, so it
does not prove the exact device-side cause. This build corrects the rigid
30-second original deadline and exposes remaining failures precisely; actual
X-T20 export must still be checked. The raw file is not re-encoded or replaced
by its preview. No live/RAF capability, native Android UI acceptance, phone
installation or publication is claimed. Prior validation records/APKs remain.
Unchanged Wi-Fi/preferences suites are not claimed rerun this round.

PROTOCOL REFERENCES CONSULTED
https://github.com/petabyt/libfuji/blob/master/lib/fuji.c
  fuji_download_file_ex uses indexed partial-object reads and correct-size mode.
https://github.com/petabyt/libfuji/blob/master/lib/fuji.h
  FUJI_MAX_PARTIAL_OBJECT is1 MiB; new requests remain below that maximum.

connect and confirm the phone, then retry the affected JPEG export.
If it still fails, the new message identifies the actual command and progress.
